en.headline: International oil painting exchange exhibition opens at Central Library
en.dek: The second Hong Kong–Beijing–Moscow–St Petersburg–Paris International Oil Painting Exchange Exhibition runs from 11 to 16 August, featuring more than 240 works by local and overseas artists.
body: The Hong Kong Oil Painting Research Society opened its second International Oil Painting Exchange Exhibition at the Hong Kong Central Library on Tuesday, bringing together works from Hong Kong, Beijing, Moscow, St Petersburg and Paris.

The six-day show, supported by the Hong Kong Arts Development Council and co-organised with Cypress Seed Gallery, displays more than 240 oil paintings by over 50 Hong Kong artists of different generations alongside pieces by professors and artists from the Central Academy of Fine Arts in Beijing and leading Russian and French institutions.

Public programmes during the exhibition include talks by visiting artists such as Russian Repin Academy professor Nikita Mogilevtsev, live portrait demonstrations, a lecture by painter Shen Ping, and guided tours for secondary-school students. Admission is free.
The society said the event aims to promote traditional oil-painting techniques and cross-cultural exchange. The exhibition continues daily until 16 August at the library’s exhibition galleries.

zh.headline: 國際油畫交流大展中央圖書館揭幕
zh.dek: 第二屆香港—北京—莫斯科—聖彼得堡—巴黎國際油畫交流大展今日起至16日在中央圖書館舉行，展出超過240幅本地及海外作品。
body: 香港油畫研究會周二於香港中央圖書館開幕第二屆國際油畫交流大展，匯聚香港、北京、莫斯科、聖彼得堡及巴黎的油畫作品。
為期六天的展覽獲香港藝術發展局贊助，並由Cypress Seed Gallery協辦，展出超過240幅油畫，包括50多位本港老中青油畫家作品，以及北京中央美術學院教授、俄羅斯及法國藝術家的畫作。
展覽期間安排公開活動，包括俄羅斯列賓美術學院教授Nikita Mogilevtsev講畫、現場肖像寫生示範、畫家沈平演講，以及中學生導賞團。入場免費。
主辦單位表示，展覽旨在推廣傳統油畫技法及跨文化交流。展覽每日開放至8月16日，地點為中央圖書館展覽館。
